firstPlayerRule: The jazziest player starts; turns then proceed clockwise.
clarifications: The first player draws four cards for the opening hand; each other player draws five.

internalEvidence: The publisher-hosted English rulebook was rendered at PDF/printed page 9. Its First Player section gives the jazziest-player criterion and clockwise order, and the next section gives the opening hand sizes. Bebop, Big Shot, character boards and bounty cards match inventory BGG 283642. SHA-256: 4b45f793013f6512b859e27a563ced95d622eb61aab88e9db5c1419617bafa35. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: The manual does not define “jazziest” or provide a tie procedure.
